card.name: Web address endings like .com
card.fires_on: The domain ending (.com, .org, .net, .html) right after a website name in a URL, usually in a 'for more information, visit www...' line.

modes.label: Domain endings
modes.description: The .com, .org or .net ending after a www site name.
modes.example: To learn more about IXL Learning, please visit www.ixl<<.com>>.

modes.label: File endings in long URLs
modes.description: The .html ending after a long path in a web address.

card.plain: It lights up on the .com or .org at the end of a web address given as a place to learn more.
